name: Gjensidige Forsikring ASA
summary: Gjensidige Forsikring ASA, together with its subsidiaries, provides general insurance and pension products in Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Finland, Latvia, Lithuania, and Estonia. It operates in four segments: General Insurance Private, General Insurance Commercial, General Insurance Sweden, and Pension. The company offers motor, property, travel, accident and health, general liability, natural perils, agriculture, medical treatment and expense, disability, income protection, workers' compensation, motor vehicle liability, marine, aviation, transport, fire and other damage to property, assistance, other non-life, and life insurance products, as well as non-proportional non-life reinsurance produ…
